content:
Hi

I am hoping to make a small first contribution to mathlib4.
There is no HasDerivWithinAt.of_local_left_inverse.
This appears to be a gap, given there is HasFDerivWithinAt.of_local_left_inverse, and the pair HasDerivAt.of_local_left_inverse and HasFDerivAt.of_local_left_inverse.

My proposal is to add HasDerivWithinAt.of_local_left_inverse next to HasDerivAt.of_local_left_inverse in Mathlib/Analysis/Calculus/Deriv/Inverse.lean (specifically here), with a proof that specialises HasFDerivWithinAt.of_local_left_inverse to scalars.

Disclosure: This gap was brought to my attention by Claude, which assisted with a workaround here. The use case there requires the right derivative of the inverse of an IVP solution at the initial point.

Is this wanted? If someone could confirm, I will raise a small PR.
Thanks

Yes, having this lemma seems reasonable. I'm not sure if the proof should specialize HasFDerivWithinAt.of_local_left_inverseor generalize HasDerivAt.of_local_left_inverse; hopefully, both would amount to the same. You should then be able to golf HasDerivAt.of_local_left_inverse using your new lemma.
Thank you -- I'll start the PR, and try to do as you suggest.
